candidates.name: Klippel-Trenaunay syndrome
support_spans: multiple cutaneous red papules
Numerous bright red macules, papules, and plaques
hemorrhagic crust and dark scale
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of multiple cutaneous red papules and plaques with ulceration and bleeding is consistent with Klippel-Trenaunay syndrome.

candidates.name: Sturge-Weber syndrome
support_spans: Numerous bright red macules, papules, and plaques
enhancing exophytic soft tissue polyps in neck and scalp
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of cutaneous lesions and enhancing exophytic soft tissue polyps is consistent with Sturge-Weber syndrome.

candidates.name: Kaposi sarcoma
support_spans: upper dermal lobulated capillary proliferation

Smooth muscle actin (SMA): positive
candidates.why: The patient's histopathology results showing upper dermal lobulated capillary proliferation and positive immunohistochemistry for CD31 and SMA are consistent with Kaposi sarcoma.
